{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for the sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"\nNumber of -1 in customer_age: {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Check the revenue column — is it string? Are there commas?
print(f"\nUnique values in revenue (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for the QA orders
print(f"\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check status values
print(f"\nStatus value counts:\n{df['status'].value_counts()}\n")"}
